# Victor de Paiva

> Victor de Paiva is a Brazilian game developer from Rio de Janeiro, Founder & CEO of the indie studio Garoa Studios, and Product Manager, spawnd.gg (Nuuvem).

- Also known as: Victor Hugo Ferreira de Paiva (legal name). Not the same person as other people with that name on LinkedIn or in business registries.
- Games: Astro Pig (2024), Cat Leather Jackets (2023), Stand By Me (2021), Cartomante – Fortune Teller (2020), RhythMania (RitMania in Portuguese; in development, selected for a R$250k RioFilme grant in Oct 2026).
- Official profiles: Bluesky @victordepaiva.com, X @otakumaromba, Instagram/TikTok/Threads @victordepaiva.rio. X @victordepaiva and Instagram @victordepaiva are not his.
